reference.title: Instalações de ar-condicionado — Sistemas centrais e unitários — Parte 3: Qualidade do ar interior
reference.note: ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 is treated as a contextual standard reference for HVAC-related IAQ and ventilation topics. This record preserves the Dossier limitation: no new universal RH threshold was identified for the Part 3 scope.

parameterDefinition.name: Relative Humidity
parameterDefinition.description: Indoor relative humidity as a monitored environmental parameter. The consolidated ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 record does not identify a new universal threshold for this Part 3 scope.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: Relative humidity monitoring as an environmental variable; no new Part 3 threshold was consolidated in this dossier.

criteria.methodNote: ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 recognizes relative humidity as a parameter of interest and monitoring/visualization variable, but the consolidated dossier did not identify a new universal threshold for the Part 3 scope. Values of other standards must not be copied into this record.
criteria.temporalGuidance: Relative humidity remains a monitoring variable for contextual interpretation. No automatic compliance threshold is assigned in this record.

curation.curationNotes: Curated from the consolidated dossier. Relative humidity is retained as a monitoring/visualization parameter only; no new universal threshold from ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 was identified.

validation.validationNotes: The consolidated dossier identifies humidity as a parameter of interest without a new universal threshold under ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024. Independent primary-source validation remains pending.
